summary: This bill expands the Secret Service's authority to investigate crimes involving money laundering, structured transactions, and fraud against financial institutions, including those related to digital assets, and extends the period for which the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) can share information with financial institutions.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands the investigative authority of the Secret Service to include money laundering and structured transactions, particularly in the context of cybercrime. It also extends the duration of the FinCEN exchange program and mandates a GAO study on law enforcement's ability to deter cyber-money laundering. These provisions directly strengthen law enforcement's capacity to investigate and prosecute financial crimes, leading to stricter justice.
